deviations.what: the sap.f.HeroBanner control is newer than 1.71 (sap/f/HeroBanner.js: @ui5-experimental-since 1.152 - an EXPERIMENTAL wrapper around the UI5 Web Components fiori HeroBanner, extending sap.ui.core.webc.WebComponent) and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.152. HeroBanner members used: the actions, startContent and endContent aggregations, columnsRatio (sap.f.HeroBannerColumnsRatio Equal, FirstWider), actionsPlacement (sap.f.HeroBannerActionsPlacement BottomStart) and headerBlockPlacement (sap.f.HeroBannerHeaderBlockPlacement Bottom) - all @ui5-experimental-since 1.152 with the control.

The sample's main.css (one rule, .heroBannerWhiteText { color: var(--sapTextInvertedColor) }, the class the startContent Text carries) is shipped with the port: it is injected through a core:HTML control carrying a <style> block (the documented CAPABILITIES form, as in apps 026/028/122), so the port adds one core:HTML control the original view does not have - the original loads the stylesheet through its manifest's sap.ui5/resources/css entry instead. The rule is verbatim, only whitespace-collapsed; its literal braces are escaped in a backtick literal because the XMLView parser reads an unescaped brace as a binding.
